monetization_evidence.evidence: Caption of the 10.2M-view reel C-ks822KeDg: 'Modernism touched by light 💥 @abdullahaslanoglu_ #REKLAM #building #buildingdesign #3dbuilding ... #render #istanbul #villa #villadesign ...'. '#REKLAM' is Turkish for 'advertisement' and is the ad-disclosure tag used in Turkey. No brand is tagged. The only account mentioned is the creator himself, so the tag most likely marks self-promotion of his own design/render work. That reading is an interpretation, not confirmed.

Caption of C_DtJZ-KOmX: 'Luxury dining area concept. 😍❤️‍🔥 Designer @abdullahaslanoglu_ #reklam #işbirliği değildir. ...'. 'işbirliği değildir' means 'is not a collaboration'. The creator explicitly says this is NOT a brand collaboration while still adding the ad tag, so it is self-promotion as a designer.
